001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text;
002
003import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006/**
007 * The Texts of the translation.
008 */
009public interface Text {
010
011  /**
012   * Getting the text that use specify locale
013   *
014   * @param locale The minecraft locale code (like en_us)
015   *
016   * @return The text
017   */
018  @NotNull
019  Component forLocale(@NotNull String locale);
020
021  /**
022   * Getting the text for player locale
023   *
024   * @return Getting the text for player locale
025   */
026  @NotNull
027  Component forLocale();
028
029  /**
030   * Getting the plain text for player locale
031   *
032   * @return The plain text for player locale
033   */
034  @NotNull
035  String plain();
036
037  /**
038   * Getting the plain text for player locale
039   *
040   * @param locale The minecraft locale code (like en_us)
041   *
042   * @return The plain text for player locale
043   */
044
045  @NotNull
046  String plain(@NotNull String locale);
047
048  /**
049   * Getting the legacy text for player locale
050   *
051   * @return The legacy text for player locale
052   */
053  @NotNull
054  String legacy();
055
056  /**
057   * Getting the legacy text for player locale
058   *
059   * @param locale The minecraft locale code (like en_us)
060   *
061   * @return The legacy text for player locale
062   */
063
064  @NotNull
065  String legacy(@NotNull String locale);
066
067  /**
068   * Getting this text is exists in the translation file
069   *
070   * @return true if this text is exists in the translation file
071   */
072  boolean isPresent();
073
074  /**
075   * Send text to the player
076   */
077  void send();
078}
